messages:
marta: bringing up calyx13b-int4 on dedicated yesterday — seeing two things: (1) a small but measurable quality dip on summarization evals vs fp16, and (2) memory spikes causing occasional OOMs when requests hit long max_new_tokens (~>512).
vik: thanks — can you paste the failing trace/log?
marta: log snippet from runner: ```
E 2026-03-18T09:12:23Z runtime: oom allocating 2048MB on heap
WARN kv_cache: slot_eviction: scanned 48 slots, freed 0
INFO prefetch: inflight 128 requests, queue len 32
```
sam: hunch: int4 build + aggressive prefetch + high max_new_tokens is fragmenting GPU memory pools. we've seen similar pattern on other 13b-sized models.
carla: any differences in allocator metrics vs other 13b canaries?
marta: yes — pool 0 free_chunks drops much faster, and compaction runs are infrequent. run dump: ```
$ runtimes dump-mem --pool 0 --stats
pool0: total=48GB free=1.2GB largest_free=120MB n_chunks=3421
compaction: last_run=+2h30m
```
vik: ok. pragmatic plan: 1) lower default max_new_tokens for calyx13b to 256 to reduce peak allocation; 2) disable prefetch on int4 canary and use conservative batching (microbatch size 1, batch_timeout 10ms); 3) bump KV eviction aggressiveness (kv_prune_threshold -> 0.6) and trigger compaction more often.
sam: +1. Also add a temporary memory cushion: reserve 1.5GB static for allocator to avoid OOM spikes when large generations occur.
carla: quick config patch (canary only): ```json
{
  "model": "calyx13b-int4",
  "defaults": {
    "max_new_tokens": 256,
    "prefetch": false,
    "batching": { "microbatch": 1, "batch_timeout_ms": 10 },
    "kv_prune_threshold": 0.6,
    "allocator_reserve_mb": 1536
  }
}
```
marta: deploying canary now (will route 2% traffic). deploy-bot: canary created calyx13b-int4-canary v1 -> infra pool-a.
deploy-bot: @marta canary 2% -> pool-a started at 09:24.
infra-bot: FYI I pushed a runtime tweak: compaction interval reduced from 10m -> 3m for pool-a.
vik: for the quality regression: run a focused eval harness comparing top-k/top-p behavior vs fp16 on the summarization set (50 prompts). collect BLEU/ROUGE and human-flagged hallucination counts.
sam: I'll run it. quick perf checklist: record latency P50/P95, token throughput, and memory high-water mark.
marta: results in ~30m. initial smoke: quality gap is small (~1.8 ROUGE-L) mostly on edge-case truncation; may be quantization side effect on vocabulary logits.
carla: action items: @sam run eval + perf, @marta monitor canary OOMs for 2h, @vik draft rollback thresholds (error rate >1% or OOMs >5 in 10m).
marta: ack. if canary stable for 2h we roll to 25% and enable light prefetch with capped inflight=8.
sam: started eval job 3523456805, posting results when done.
carla: nice concise plan — also add a regression alert to Optimize: quality delta > 1.0 should fire a regression ticket.
marta: noted. thanks team. :thumbsup:
